chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali Al-Washsha', from Ahmad ibn 'A'idh, from Abi Khadijah Salim ibn Mukarram Al-Jammal, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When Fatimah gave birth to Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Jabra'il came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said to him, 'Your nation will kill Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) after you.' Then he said, 'Shall I not show you some of his dust?' So he struck the ground with his wing and brought forth dust from the land of Karbala and showed it to him, then said, 'This is the dust on which he will be killed.'

key_terms.يُقْتَلُ عَلَيْهَا: He will be killed upon it

ai.seo_question: What did the angel Jabra'il show the Prophet Muhammad regarding Imam Al-Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the concept of *Turbat al-Husayn* (the soil of Karbala) as a tangible sign of prophetic foreknowledge, linking the physical geography of Karbala to the cosmic destiny of the Ahl al-Bayt. In Shia tradition, this event underscores the inevitability of the martyrdom despite the Prophet's grief, serving as a foundational text for the spiritual significance of Karbala's soil in rituals and theology.
